description: Schedule work by energy, not just time — the week of self-observation that maps your real peaks and troughs, the work-to-energy matching (hard creative work on peaks, admin on slopes, meetings on shoulders), and the calendar rebuild that honors the map. Use when asked when should I do my hardest work, I waste my best hours on email, map my energy levels, or why is 3pm always useless.
